note: Pieces of Natural Earth's modern countries that changed hands inside the period, split out so a polity can be assembled from them. Each part takes the source country's polygons that fall entirely inside `within` ([west, south, east, north]); the source country keeps the rest. Referenced by id from the files in data/polities/.

crimea.name: Crimea
crimea.why: Natural Earth draws Crimea as part of Russia. Splitting it out lets it sit under Ukraine before 2014 and Russia after.
